analysis.summaryJa: 自動詞は目的語を直接取らず動作だけで文の核が完結する。後ろに場所・時・様子が続いても、それらは修飾情報であり目的語とは限らない。また活動名の表し方としてplay＋球技・ゲーム、practice＋競技・稽古、活動自体が動詞になる型を区別する。
grammarPoints: 場所・時・様子の修飾語と目的語の区別
活動自体を動詞として使う
visualEvidence: 目的語ありと目的語なしの対比
SVレールの外側に修飾情報が浮かぶ図
commonTraps: 動詞後の語をすべて目的語と考える
前置詞句を直接目的語と誤認する
活動動詞に不要なplayを付ける

questions.prompt: The conference ended ------- at 4:30 P.M.

choices.B: the agenda

questions.translationJa: 会議は午後4時30分に滞りなく終了しました。
questions.explanationJa: endedはここで自動詞で、smoothlyは動作の様子を足す副詞です。

questions.prompt: Several guests arrived ------- before the opening ceremony.

choices.B: early

questions.translationJa: 数名の来客は開会式前に早く到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: arrivedは目的語なしで完結し、earlyは時の様子を加えます。

questions.prompt: Our employees ------- volleyball every Wednesday after work.

choices.B: skate

questions.translationJa: 社員は毎週水曜日の勤務後にバレーボールをします。
questions.explanationJa: 球技volleyballにはplayを使います。

questions.prompt: Ms. Sato ------- aikido at a community center on Fridays.

choices.B: goes

questions.translationJa: 佐藤さんは金曜日に地域センターで合気道を稽古します。
questions.explanationJa: 稽古・競技としてaikidoを行う場合practiceが自然です。

questions.prompt: The indicator light ------- continuously during the system update.

choices.B: the screen

questions.translationJa: システム更新中、表示灯は連続して点滅しました。
questions.explanationJa: blinkは動作だけで完結でき、continuouslyは修飾語です。

questions.prompt: The visitors waited ------- for nearly twenty minutes.

choices.B: outside

questions.translationJa: 来訪者は外で約20分待ちました。
questions.explanationJa: outsideは場所を示す修飾語で、waitedの直接目的語ではありません。

questions.prompt: After work, several staff members ------- along the riverside path.

choices.B: do run

questions.translationJa: 仕事後、数人の社員が川沿いの道をジョギングします。
questions.explanationJa: jog自体が活動を表す動詞なのでplayやdoは不要です。

questions.prompt: The audience remained ------- throughout the safety announcement.

choices.B: the speaker

questions.translationJa: 聴衆は安全案内の間ずっと静かなままでした。
questions.explanationJa: remainは目的語ではなく主語を説明する補語quietを取ります。目的語の有無を意味関係で判断します。

questions.prompt: The delivery truck stopped ------- outside the loading area, but it blocked no entrance.

choices.B: the loading area directly

questions.translationJa: 配送トラックは荷捌き場の外で短時間停止しましたが、入口は塞ぎませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: stoppedは自動詞で、brieflyは時間の長さを修飾します。

questions.prompt: Although several details followed the verb, the sentence “The technician worked in the lab all night” has ------- direct object.

choices.B: no

questions.translationJa: その文には動詞の後ろに複数の情報がありますが、直接目的語はありません。
questions.explanationJa: in the labとall nightは場所・時の修飾で、workedが作用する『何を』ではありません。
questions.focus: 修飾語と目的語の高度な識別

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with an intransitive verb followed only by a modifier.

choices.B: The bell rang the visitors.

questions.translationJa: ベルは大きな音で鳴りました。
questions.explanationJa: rangは動作だけで完結し、loudlyは様子を加える副詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence about a ball sport.

choices.B: We practice to tennis after work.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは仕事後にテニスをします。
questions.explanationJa: 球技・ゲーム名には基本的にplayを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural sentence about a martial art.

choices.B: Ken practices karate every Saturday.

questions.translationJa: ケンは毎週土曜日に空手を稽古します。
questions.explanationJa: 稽古として行う競技にはpracticeが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence in which the activity word itself is the verb.

choices.A: They play skate near the hotel.
choices.B: They do skating as a verb near the hotel.
choices.D: They practice to skate near the hotel.

questions.translationJa: 彼らはホテルの近くでスケートをします。
questions.explanationJa: skate自体が動詞として活動を表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with no direct object.

choices.A: The elevator stopped on the third floor.
choices.B: The clerk stopped the elevator.

questions.translationJa: エレベーターは3階で止まりました。
questions.explanationJa: on the third floorは場所であり、stoppedの直接目的語ではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where words after the verb are only time and manner information.

choices.A: The staff completed the report quickly.
choices.B: The staff discussed the report yesterday.
choices.C: The staff prepared the room carefully.
choices.D: The staff worked efficiently all morning.

questions.translationJa: スタッフは午前中ずっと効率よく働きました。
questions.explanationJa: efficientlyとall morningはいずれもworkedを修飾し、目的語ではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct analysis of “The guests arrived at the venue before noon.”

choices.A: arrived takes venue as a direct object.
choices.B: The sentence has no direct object; both following phrases add place or time.
choices.C: before noon is the direct object.

questions.translationJa: この文に直接目的語はなく、後続の句は場所と時を加えています。
questions.explanationJa: at the venueとbefore noonは前置詞句で、arrivedの対象ではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence whose verb changes from an intransitive to a transitive use.

choices.B: The meeting continued for an hour.
choices.C: The assistant opened the door slowly.

questions.translationJa: アシスタントはドアをゆっくり開けました。
questions.explanationJa: openedの作用がthe doorへ直接届くため、この用法では他動詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where a prepositional phrase must not be mistaken for an object.

choices.A: The analyst spoke about the forecast for ten minutes.
choices.B: The analyst reviewed the forecast for ten minutes.
choices.C: The analyst revised the forecast yesterday.
choices.D: The analyst presented the forecast clearly.

questions.translationJa: 分析担当者は予測について10分間話しました。
questions.explanationJa: about the forecastは前置詞句で、spokeの直接目的語ではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that is correctly classified as an SV core despite several following words.

choices.A: The engineer tested the new unit yesterday.
choices.B: The engineer repaired the unit in the lab.
choices.C: The engineer carried the unit upstairs.
choices.D: The engineer worked in the lab until midnight.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は真夜中まで研究室で働きました。
questions.explanationJa: 核はThe engineer workedで完結し、後ろは場所と時の情報です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure and meaning to: “The alarm sounded loudly.”

choices.A: The alarm made a loud sound without acting on an object.
choices.B: The alarm sounded the staff directly.
choices.D: The alarm described loudness as an object.

questions.translationJa: 警報は目的語に作用せず、大きな音を出しました。
questions.explanationJa: soundはここで自動詞で、loudlyは様子を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We play badminton after work.”

choices.A: We use badminton as a verb by itself.
choices.B: Badminton is the ball/racket game we take part in after work.
choices.C: We practice a martial art called badminton.
choices.D: We arrive at badminton after work.

questions.translationJa: バドミントンは私たちが仕事後に行う球技です。
questions.explanationJa: badmintonのようなゲーム・球技はplayの対象として表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The courier waited outside for ten minutes.”

choices.A: The courier waited an object called outside.
choices.B: Ten minutes received the waiting action.
choices.C: The courier's waiting was complete by itself; the rest tells where and how long.

questions.translationJa: 配達員のwaitedだけで動作は完結し、残りは場所と時間を示します。
questions.explanationJa: outsideとfor ten minutesは修飾情報です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Maya swims every morning.”

choices.B: Maya practices an object named swim.
choices.C: Every morning is Maya's direct object.
choices.D: Swimming itself is the activity expressed by the verb swims.

questions.translationJa: swimsという動詞そのものがマヤの水泳活動を表します。
questions.explanationJa: swimは活動自体を動詞として表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure to: “The machine stopped suddenly.”

choices.A: The machine's stopping action ended without a direct object, and suddenly describes it.
choices.B: The machine stopped a sudden object.
choices.D: The machine made suddenly its object.

questions.translationJa: 機械の停止動作は目的語なしで完結し、suddenlyがその様子を説明します。
questions.explanationJa: stopの自動詞用法です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “They practice judo twice a week.”

choices.A: They play a ball game called judo.
choices.B: They train in the martial art of judo twice each week.
choices.C: They use judo as an intransitive verb.
choices.D: They arrive at judo twice weekly.

questions.translationJa: 彼らは週2回、柔道の稽古をします。
questions.explanationJa: practiceは稽古・訓練として競技を行う意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure to: “The manager spoke in the lobby after lunch.”
